title: Lost Ticket Processing
overview: Authorized staff recover the unique open parking session, record verification, and route the resolved charge through normal payment and exit.
preconditions: The staff user has an allowed role.
The driver provides a vehicle number and verification details.
main_flow: Staff searches by normalized vehicle number.
The system finds the unique OPEN ticket.
The system charges the greater of the normal fee and lost-ticket fee.
The normal payment and exit flow closes the original ticket.
The system records an audit event.

alternative_flows.condition: No unique OPEN ticket is found.
alternative_flows.result: Escalate to a parking manager without accepting automatic payment.

business_rules: Do not create a second parking session.
Audit staff identity, ticket, timestamp, and verification note.
